C-NATIVE-DOCX-RTF-EXPORT.IntentSummary: Ship "Export to Word…" in the File menu and a fourth export group in the tab context menu, backed by a renderer-only pipeline: the existing styled-HTML export (muya's own marked-fork render) through the M-065 image-embed pass, a data-only pre-pass (strip pre.front-matter, adapt footnote markup, rasterize figures to PNG), a lazy docx/docx-html dynamic import (htmlToContent + styleMap, geometry from the remembered print options), Packer.toBlob, and the existing binary write facade. Modal-less by owner decision; the success toast carries a quiet "Export settings" actions descriptor the legacy notify drops silently and the notification rework renders automatically. RTF is out of v1. Implementation queues behind the P1 print-crash fix (2.8.1) merging to main.

MustPassCommand.Command: npx playwright test tests/e2e/export-office.spec.ts tests/e2e/print-export.spec.ts tests/e2e/export-html-images.spec.ts --project=chromium
npx --yes --package license-checker -- license-checker --production --json | node tools/build-notices-node.mjs | diff -u NOTICES-node.md -

T-001.Title: Dependency and attribution ground: docx ^9.14.0 npm dependency (lockfile-pinned), NOTICES-node.md regeneration, README Acknowledgements line, and the check-export-chunk.mjs lazy-chunk guard script

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: package.json and package-lock.json carry docx at the pinned exact version (npm ci reproduces it); docx is imported nowhere outside the lazy dynamic-import path in code that exists after this task; NOTICES-node.md contains the docx MIT notice and regenerating it is a no-op (git diff clean); README Acknowledgements gains the docx line; scripts/check-export-chunk.mjs exists, exits 0 on the current build (no docx in the entry chunk yet) and is wired as a package.json script.

Verification.Command: npx --yes --package license-checker -- license-checker --production --json | node tools/build-notices-node.mjs | diff -u NOTICES-node.md -

T-002.Title: Pin muya's real export-HTML shapes as fixtures: footnote class/role markup, pre.front-matter block, task checkboxes, KaTeX MathML presence, on the shared EN+RU fixture document

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: tests/renderer/util/export-docx-shapes.test.js drives the real editor.value.exportStyledHTML (same composition as the styledHtml branch) on the EN+RU fixture (headings, math inline+display, footnotes RU with bold, task list, table alignments, code, hard break, front matter, data-URL image) and asserts the exact shapes the pre-pass depends on: section.footnotes[role=doc-endnotes] with li#fn items and a.footnote-ref[role=doc-noteref] references; pre.front-matter block present (to be stripped); input[type=checkbox] items; katex-mathml MathML inside math spans; no dependency on docx anywhere in this test file.

T-003.Title: exportDocx.js pipeline (M-066) and its unit matrix: embedLocalImages reuse, pre-pass (front-matter strip, footnote markup adaptation, figure PNG raster in document order), lazy docx import, htmlToContent + styleMap, Document geometry from the remembered print options, Packer.toBlob, hostile-text round-trip and OOXML-level output assertions

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: tests/renderer/util/export-docx.test.js unzips the produced buffers (a zip reader from the existing dependency set or one added dev dependency) and asserts on the EN+RU fixtures: Heading1..Heading6 pStyles; w:tbl with per-column w:jc; w:hyperlink resolving in document.xml.rels; monospace code runs; w14:checkbox elements whose w14:checked values equal the fixture states; m:oMath equations containing m:f and m:nary structures with readable math text; word/footnotes.xml carrying the RU footnote text with its bold run; zero front-matter text; sectPr matching the injected print options (landscape-A4 variant included); the numbered-list display formula carrying no numPr (numbering walk renders 1, 2); the hostile fixture (braces, control bytes, fake footnote markup, fake style attributes) round-trips with text nodes equal to source; figure fixtures land as media in document order; the 8 MiB cap and skip accounting reuse the M-065 semantics.

T-004.Title: Menu, store and localization wiring: file.export-file-docx menu item (m009), editor.vue handleExport 'docx' case (no modal ever mounts), store EXPORT 'docx' branch (save dialog .docx default name, binary write via the C-56 fileUtils facade, success toast + quiet "Export settings" actions descriptor, editor.export.failed on error), all ten locales including the action label

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: m009_menu.rs registers file.export-file-docx beside the pdf/html items (command exportDocx, label localized through the existing menu i18n path); the handleExport regex admits 'docx' and the case delegates to exportDocx with zero exportSettings involvement; the store branch mirrors the html defaultName logic (.md → .docx, untitled → title-or-export), writes through the same facade the C-56 picture export uses, passes the actions descriptor (quiet Export settings, source 'export') on success — a unit test pins the exact notify call shape (legacy wrapper ignores extras) — and cancels silently; ten locale files carry the menu label, tab labels, notice and the action label as native copy with verified placeholders.

T-005.Title: Tab context menu fourth group: Export to PDF… / Export to HTML… / Export to Word… items with the !!pathname gate, label parity with the File menu, and activate-then-export handler semantics

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: contextMenu/tabs/index.js appends the fourth group after the file block with enabled: !!pathname exactly like Copy path; labels reuse the identical locale keys as the File menu items; the handler activates the clicked tab first (by the tab.id it already receives) and then dispatches the same export command the menu item uses; untitled tabs show all three disabled; a unit test (tests/renderer/contextMenu/tabs-export.test.js) pins the group structure, gating and handler dispatch for a background tab.

T-006.Title: E2E coverage and the chunk guard in the gate: export-office.spec.ts (docx flow with the no-modal pin, cancel, tab-menu group on background/untitled tabs, regression pins that pdf/print/styledHtml branches and mt_export_pdf/mt_print_webview stay untouched) plus check-export-chunk.mjs enforcing entry-chunk cleanliness and the ≤ 300 KB gzip docx chunk

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: tests/e2e/export-office.spec.ts (tauri-shim) passes on chromium: Export to Word… opens the save dialog with a .docx default name, writes via mt_fs_write_binary, and no export-settings component ever mounts (pinned); cancel writes nothing and shows no notice; the tab-menu group shows three items, gated on untitled, and a background-tab export activates then exports that tab's buffer; print-export.spec.ts and export-html-images.spec.ts pass unmodified; the built output shows zero docx bytes in the entry chunk and the docx dynamic chunk ≤ 300 KB gzip (guard exits non-zero otherwise).

Verification.Command: npx playwright test tests/e2e/export-office.spec.ts tests/e2e/print-export.spec.ts tests/e2e/export-html-images.spec.ts --project=chromium

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: npm test green; the regression trio green; the manual checklist executed on a real build: both fixtures open without warnings in Word, Pages and LibreOffice; page geometry matches the remembered options on the landscape-A4 fixture; the display formula in the numbered list renders 1, 2; front matter absent; code blocks monospace; the 100 KB stress fixture and the 27 KB CJK/330-math sample each export in under 3 seconds on the dev machine; per-construct verdicts and timings recorded in docs/office-export-checklist.md.
